analysis.title: Taiwan ODM/Brands: 3-month preview: new AI server racks and smartphone models to drive growth in coming months
key_insights: GS previews 3-month revenues for 8 Taiwan AI server/PC supply chain names and updates estimates for Asus, Compal, Inventec and Pegatron. Ratings: Buy on Hon Hai, Wiwynn and Wistron, Neutral on Quanta, Inventec, Compal and ASUS, Sell on Pegatron.

GS expects average revenue growth of the 8 companies at -2% / 0% / 1% MoM in Oct / Nov / Dec 2026. Revenue is largely flat because AI server models are transitioning and consumer electronics demand is modest under high memory costs and consumption pull-in.

GS expects average YoY revenue growth of +68% / +60% / +44% in Oct / Nov / Dec 2026. Drivers are continued AI server ramp-up, a PC product mix upgrade, new smartphone models, and high memory costs raising selling prices.
GS is positive on three areas: Apple's supply chain (foldable phones in 2026, iPhone 20 in 2027), AI server components benefiting from specification upgrades, and rising ASIC AI server penetration.

Hon Hai (Buy, on Conviction List, TP NT$400): 4Q26E revenue is forecast at NT$4.2 trillion, +61% YoY and +39% QoQ. GS expects Hon Hai to deliver the latest AI server rack model 2-3 months ahead of peers, with LPU-powered racks driving growth from December and into 1Q27.

GS sees AI server rack global value TAM growing at a 163% CAGR in 2025-28E to US$1tn, or 63% of global server value TAM by 2028E. Global NVIDIA/AMD AI server rack shipments are put at 63k / 110k / 164k in 2026E-28E.

GS raised leading US CSP aggregate capex estimates by 4% / 17% / 22% in 2026E-28E to US$1,397bn by 2028E, and raised implied AI chip shipments by 9% / 19% in 2027 / 28E with ASIC penetration reaching 58% by 2028E.

GS cut global smartphone volume estimates by 1m / 8m / 0.2m units to 1.1bn / 1.2bn / 1.2bn in 2026-28E (-10% / +2% / +2% YoY) on high memory costs. It still expects leading global brands to outperform and premium and foldable models to gain share, which helps Hon Hai.

Quanta (Neutral, TP NT$300): Sep revenue fell 23% MoM on AI server model transition, while PC shipments rose 62% MoM into quarter-end. GS expects sequential growth Oct to Dec but 4Q26E revenue down 4% QoQ on a high 3Q26 base and gradual ramp of new racks.

Wiwynn (Buy, TP NT$4,000): Sep revenue beat GS by 19% on general server demand from US CSPs and a new ASIC AI server ramp. 4Q26E revenue is forecast at +60% YoY and +8% QoQ, with new NVIDIA and AMD GPU racks entering mass production in 4Q26 and potential new ASIC customers.

Wistron (Buy, TP NT$291): Sep revenue was 18% below GS on shipment timing of higher-ASP AI products. GS expects new GPU, CPU and LPU racks to lift ASP from 4Q26 and 2H26 revenue to rise 41% HoH despite weak PC shipments (-32% YoY in Sep).

ASUS (Neutral, TP NT$1,115): GS expects 4Q26E revenue down 6% QoQ but up 27% YoY on PC mix upgrade and AI server rack ramp. The company issued US$0.5bn of convertible bonds and US$1bn of exchangeable bonds to fund capacity expansion. Estimates are essentially unchanged.

Compal (Neutral, TP NT$46.1): Sep revenue rose 40% MoM on AI server rack shipments. 4Q26E revenue is forecast at +46% YoY and +15% QoQ. FY26E net income was cut 3% on higher R&D, and PC demand is weak under rising memory cost.

Inventec (Neutral, TP NT$61): Sep revenue beat GS by 20%, but GS models a sequential decline in Oct on a high base, tight component supply and sluggish PC demand. 2026-28E net income was raised 9% / 6% / 14% and the target P/E cut to 14.2x from 15.3x.

Pegatron (Sell, TP cut to NT$73.3 from NT$76.9): Sep revenue was 64% above GS on an AI server ramp. 2026-28E revenue estimates rose 16% / 28% / 27%, but gross profit rose less (9% / 12% / 15%) because AI server racks carry much lower gross margins. Sell is maintained on stretched valuation.

market_movers.rationale: Hon Hai (2317.TW) is Buy on the Conviction List. GS expects new AI server racks, CPO switches and foldable phone models to drive 4Q26E revenue +39% QoQ. TP is based on 17.9x 2027E P/E.
Wiwynn (6669.TW) gets new ASIC and GPU AI server racks and strong general server demand. TP is unchanged at 20.3x 2027E P/E.
Wistron (3231.TW) benefits from new GPU AI server racks and customer expansion. TP is unchanged at 12.6x 2027E P/E.
Quanta (2382.TW) has AI server growth ahead, but model transition and a PC shipment slowdown could weigh on 4Q26. Rated fairly valued at 10.7x 2027E P/E.
ASUS (2357.TW) is rated Neutral on fair valuation. TP is unchanged at 14.8x 2027E P/E and estimates are largely unchanged.
Compal (2324.TW) AI servers fuel 4Q26E and 1Q27E growth. FY26E net income was cut 3% and TP is unchanged at 14.7x 2027E P/E.
Inventec (2356.TW) net income estimates rose but tight component supply weighs on near-term growth. TP is unchanged at NT$61 on a lower 14.2x target P/E.
Pegatron (4938.TW) TP was cut from NT$76.9 on a lower 9.7x target P/E. Sell is kept on stretched valuation, with AI server racks diluting gross margin.

sector_views.rationale: AI server rack ramp-up, specification upgrades and rising ASIC penetration drive YoY revenue growth of +44% to +68% across the group through Dec 2026.
High memory costs and consumption pull-in weigh on PC and smartphone demand. Sep notebook shipments fell YoY at Quanta, Compal, Wistron and Pegatron.
New models with form factor changes (foldable phones in 2026, iPhone 20 in 2027) should support end demand.

earnings_insights: Hon Hai 3Q26 revenue reported NT$3,026,912m, +47% YoY, 5% ahead of GS and 7% ahead of Bloomberg consensus. Sep revenue reported NT$1,158,633m (+38% YoY, +26% MoM), 15% above GS estimate of NT$1,009,185m. 4Q26E GS estimate NT$4,201,597m (+61% YoY, +39% QoQ).
Quanta Sep revenue reported NT$325,300m (+77% YoY, -23% MoM), 20% above GS estimate of NT$272,034m. GS estimates 4Q26E revenue NT$1,065,750m (-4% QoQ) versus 3Q26 reported NT$1,115,545m.
Wiwynn Sep revenue reported NT$172,620m (+100% YoY, +20% MoM), 19% above GS estimate of NT$145,369m. GS 4Q26E revenue estimate NT$467,521m (+60% YoY, +8% QoQ).

Wistron Sep revenue reported NT$380,806m (+87% YoY, -17% MoM), 18% below GS estimate of NT$463,004m. GS 4Q26E revenue estimate NT$1,308,630m (+82% YoY, +14% QoQ), 7% above the prior GS 4Q figure of NT$1,231,289m cited in the exhibit.

ASUS Sep revenue reported NT$97,243m (+18% YoY), 1% below GS estimate of NT$98,385m. GS 4Q26E revenue estimate NT$258,660m (+27% YoY, -6% QoQ). 2026E EPS estimate NT$76.39, 2027E NT$75.69, 2028E NT$86.71.
Compal Sep revenue reported NT$94,434m (+35% YoY, +40% MoM), 3% above GS estimate of NT$91,271m. GS 4Q26E revenue estimate NT$278,440m (+46% YoY, +15% QoQ). FY26E net income cut 3% to NT$10,356m.

Inventec Sep revenue reported NT$98,636m (+63% YoY, +18% MoM), 20% above GS estimate of NT$82,083m. GS 4Q26E revenue estimate NT$252,188m (+47% YoY, -7% QoQ). 2026-28E net income raised 9% / 6% / 14%.

Pegatron Sep revenue reported NT$214,753m (+87% YoY, +143% MoM), 64% above GS estimate of NT$131,069m. GS 4Q26E revenue estimate NT$517,268m (+62% YoY, +33% QoQ). 2026-28E net income raised 4% / 6% / 4%, but Dec 2026E revenue is forecast down 61% MoM.

trade_ideas.description: Long Hon Hai (2317.TW), Buy on the Conviction List, TP NT$400
trade_ideas.rationale: New AI server racks and CPO switches ramp 2-3 months ahead of peers, plus foldable phone model launches.
trade_ideas.risk: Slower-than-expected ramp-up of the AI server business.

trade_ideas.rationale: Ramp of major customers' new ASIC AI servers and new GPU racks in 4Q26.
New GPU AI server racks and customer expansion offset weak PC shipments.

trade_ideas.description: Short or avoid Pegatron (4938.TW), Sell, TP NT$73.3
trade_ideas.rationale: Stretched valuation, and AI server racks carry much lower gross margins than Pegatron's other products.
trade_ideas.risk: Faster-than-expected AI server ramp-up, stronger smartphone recovery or stronger consumer electronics demand.

risk_factors: Slower-than-expected ramp-up of AI servers, including the AI server model transition that cut Quanta's Sep revenue 23% MoM.
High memory and raw material costs (memory, CPU) capping PC, smartphone and consumer electronics demand.
Component short supply weighing on Inventec's near-term growth.
Consumption pull-in in 1H26 and late 2025 leaving PC shipments negative HoH.
Shipment timing volatility in higher-ASP AI products, as seen in Wistron's Sep miss.
Fiercer competition in consumer electronics EMS and the server ODM market.
Weaker-than-expected EV total solution performance and slower global capacity ramp-up (Hon Hai).
charts_described: Exhibit 7 models Hon Hai's Oct 2026 revenue at +40% YoY or +8% MoM, with monthly revenue of NT$1,251,324m in Oct, NT$1,363,943m in Nov and NT$1,586,330m in Dec 2026E.
Exhibit 15 expects ASUS Oct revenue to change +36% YoY / -7% MoM to NT$90bn.
Exhibit 17 derives ASUS's target P/E of 14.8x 2027E from peers' average ratio of 2027E P/E to 2028E NI YoY and OPM, with an average ratio of 0.7.

tension_points.bull_case: New GPU, LPU and ASIC racks ramp with higher ASP and specification upgrades. US CSP capex is raised to US$1,397bn by 2028E and Hon Hai is expected to lead with 4Q26E revenue +39% QoQ.
tension_points.bear_case: Model transition leaves monthly revenue flat to down. Quanta Sep revenue fell 23% MoM and 4Q26E is forecast -4% QoQ, Wistron Sep missed GS by 18% on shipment timing, and component short supply weighs on Inventec.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Slower-than-expected ramp-up of the AI server business, or weaker-than-expected AI server demand growth.

tension_points.bull_case: Sep revenue beat GS by 64%, AI server shipments are ramping across rack-level and baseboard-based products, and 2026-28E revenue estimates were raised 16% / 28% / 27%.
tension_points.bear_case: AI server racks have much lower gross margin, so gross profit estimates rose only 9% / 12% / 15%, and GS sees valuation as stretched with a Sell rating and a TP cut to NT$73.3.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Faster-than-expected AI server ramp-up, stronger-than-expected smartphone market recovery or stronger-than-expected demand for consumer electronics.
